querySql:
select 
                                      object_id,
                                      f_info_windcode,
                                      trade_dt,
                                      f_avgreturn_thisweek,
                                      f_avgreturn_thismonth,
                                      f_avgreturn_thisquarter,
                                      f_avgreturn_week,
                                      f_avgreturn_month,
                                      f_avgreturn_quarter,
                                      f_avgreturn_halfyear,
                                      f_avgreturn_thisyear,
                                      f_avgreturn_year,
                                      f_avgreturn_twoyear,
                                      f_avgreturn_threeyear,
                                      f_avgreturn_fouryear,
                                      f_avgreturn_fiveyear,
                                      f_avgreturn_sixyear,
                                      f_avgreturn_sincefound,
                                      f_annualyeild,
                                      f_trackdev_thisday,
                                      f_stdarddev_halfyear,
                                      f_stdarddev_year,
                                      f_stdarddev_twoyear,
                                      f_stdarddev_threeyear,
                                      f_stdarddev_fiveyear,
                                      f_stdarddev_sincefound,
                                      f_sharpratio_halfyear,
                                      f_sharpratio_year,
                                      f_sharpratio_twoyear,
                                      f_sharpratio_threeyear,
                                      f_annualyeild_sincefound,
                                      f_avgreturn_thisday,
                                      opdate,
                                      opmode,
                                      to_char(sysdate - 1, 'yyyymmdd') as bath_dt,
                                      cast(sysdate as timestamp) as data_ins_time,
                                      'w_chfundmfperformance.json' as task_rs_id
                                from ${srcoradbname}.chfundmfperformance WHERE trade_dt BETWEEN '${busi_month}'||'01' AND to_char(add_months(to_date('${busi_month}'||'01','yyyyMMdd'),1)-1,'yyyyMMdd')
